title: Harness config recommendations tied to adapter evidence
objective: Require adapter state, install/onramp path, verification commands, risk notes, and config-preservation behavior before promoting a harness setup recommendation.
source_rule: Adapter matrix before recommendations: no native-support claim without matrix evidence.
allowed_evidence: generated MCP and rule bundles under mcps/generated/
existing user config backups and merge behavior
forbidden_actions: claiming native support for instruction-backed or reference-only harnesses
copying Claude hook semantics into Codex, Gemini, Zed, or OpenCode without adapter evidence
silently overwriting existing user MCP, hook, plugin, command, or rule config
publishing packages or plugins from this evaluator run
acceptance_gates: adapter state is retrieved from the matrix
install or onramp path is named
